title: the npc doesn't talk to me RGSS

posts.author: NaMosca
posts.body:
EDIT: FOR SOME REASON NOW ITS WORKING, PROBLEM SOLVED (AND I DON'T EDIT THE SCRIPT O.O)
Hi guys, so, I created this script to call it in a event and display an image, however if I call the script more than once disabling the image again the event/npc stops talking to me and even trying to talk to him again nothing happens nor does the script call anymore
Code:
class Sprite_Dialogo < Sprite
def initialize(viewport, image_name)
super(viewport)
@nome_avatar = image_name
@bitmap = RPG::Cache.picture(@nome_avatar)
self.bitmap = @bitmap
update_position
self.z = 9999
self.visible = false #controle pelo chamar script
end
def update_position(x = 0, y = 0)
self.x = x
self.y = y
end
def update
super
end
def dispose
@bitmap.dispose if @bitmap
super
end
end

class Spriteset_Map

  # Certifica de que o viewport está corretamente inicializado
    if @viewport1

      $sprite_dialogo.update_position(100, 144)

    end
 
end
